note: The five documented events (FLG-009: no canonical list existed in the repository; this is the adopted set — replace only by owner confirmation, Q-12). Recorded by assets/analytics.js, never containing personal data: no cookies, no IPs, no fingerprinting, Do Not Track respected.

events.name: page_view
events.why: denominator for every later ratio (views → clicks)

events.name: outbound_click
events.why: measures interest leaving the site (not just affiliate links)

events.name: affiliate_click
events.trigger: click on a product link carrying the tracking tag
events.why: the outbound-click counter the brief asks for, scoped to monetized links

events.name: search_query
events.why: demand signal from readers; queries themselves are not stored (only length) to stay privacy-preserving

events.name: article_read
events.trigger: reader scrolls ≥50% of a guide (once per page view)

endpoint.storage: append-only NDJSON, no IP or UA stored
endpoint.status: not deployed — GitHub Pages cannot host it (FLG-010, Q-08)
